name: Blunt Force Trauma

parts.label: Passive
parts.text: Passive: Dr. Mundo gains bonus attack damage.

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Dr. Mundo empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 50 bonus range, and deal bonus physical damage, increased by 0 / 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 28 / 32 / 36 / 40 (based on Dr. Mundo's missing health)%. If the target dies or is a small monster, they are sent flying away in a line, though not through terrain, causing all enemies they pass through to take 100% AD physical damage plus Blunt Force Trauma's minimum bonus damage.

mechanics.evidence: Mundo empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 50 bonus range, and deal bonus physical damage, increased by 0 / 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 28 / 32 / 36 / 40 (based on Dr. Mundo's missing health)%.

values.context: Mundo empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 50 bonus range, and deal bonus physical damage, increased by 0 / 4 / 8 / 12 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 28 / 32 / 36 / 40 (based on Dr. Mundo's missing health)%.

parts.text: Blunt Force Trauma as well as the triggering attack's damage is increased to 140% against minions and 140% against monsters.
Blunt Force Trauma resets Dr. Mundo's basic attack timer.

notes:
Blunt Force Trauma's damage is treated as basic damage but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as spell damage, while the target's body being shoved deals area damage to enemies it passes through.
  - The basic attack is also considered a part of Blunt Force Trauma and treated as both basic damage and spell damage.
Blunt Force Trauma's attack works against structures, consuming the buff and dealing its full damage.

Blunt Force Trauma cannot knock back wards, structures, epic monsters, Tentacles and W it kills, nor champions that enter a zombie state upon dying.
  - Plants and W can be flung.
Targets flung away are rendered untargetable in the process.
The damage of the enemy's corpse colliding with enemies does not benefit from Blunt Force Trauma's attack critically striking.

name: Masochism

parts.label: Passive
parts.text: Passive: Taking magic damage or paying a health cost increases Dr. Mundo's magic resistance by 3% for 2 seconds, stacking up to an amount.

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Dr. Mundo gains bonus attack damage for 5 seconds, increased by an amount based on his percentage missing health.
Additionally, Dr. Mundo's next basic attack within the duration will cost health, but gains 25 bonus range and deals bonus physical damage.
Masochism resets Dr. Mundo's basic attack timer.

notes:
Masochism's attack can be used even if Dr. Mundo doesn't have the sufficient amount of health to pay for the health cost.
  - As with all abilities with health costs, Masochism's attack will not reduce Dr. Mundo's health below 1.
The attack damage bonus is evaluated when the attack hits and thus adjusts to changes in Dr. Mundo's health.
Masochism does not apply to structures.

name: Adrenaline Rush

parts.label: Innate
parts.text: Innate: Dr. Mundo regenerates 2.5% of his maximum health every 5 seconds.

notes: Adrenaline Rush is not affected by Revitalize as it is considered as health regeneration.

name: Goes Where He Pleases

page.title: Template:Data Dr. Mundo/Goes Where He Pleases

parts.label: Innate
parts.text: Innate: Dr. Mundo regenerates an additional 0.4 – 2.3 (based on level)% of his maximum health every 5 seconds.

mechanics.evidence: Mundo regenerates an additional 0.4 – 2.3 (based on level)% of his maximum health every 5 seconds.

values.context: Mundo regenerates an additional 0.4 – 2.3 (based on level)% of his maximum health every 5 seconds.

parts.label: Passive
parts.text: Passive: Periodically, Dr. Mundo gains immunity to the next hostile immobilizing effect to affect him. Upon resisting one, Dr. Mundo pays a health cost equal to 4% of his current health and propels a canister that lands 525 units in the general direction of the immobilization source, remaining on the ground for 7 seconds.

Dr. Mundo can move near the canister to consume it, healing himself for 4% of his maximum health and reducing the cooldown of Goes Where He Pleases by 15 seconds. Enemy champions can move near it to destroy it.

mechanics.evidence: Mundo can move near the canister to consume it, healing himself for 4% of his maximum health and reducing the cooldown of Goes Where He Pleases by 15 seconds.

parts.text: Goes Where He Pleases' cooldown resets upon respawning.

notes:
Upon being triggered by a hostile immobilizing effect, Goes Where He Pleases will also grant Dr. Mundo immunity to additional immobilizing effects from the same cast instance.
  - Abilities where non-immobilizing effects and damage are nested into immobilizing ones will have them also prevented. Non-immobilizing effects and damage applied separately (the vast majority of cases) are not prevented.
Spell shield and Black Shield take priority over Goes Where He Pleases.
The canister, whether in flight and on the ground, will transition in and out of Death Realm alongside Dr. Mundo.
The canister cannot be interacted with while untargetable.

name: Infected Bonesaw

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Dr. Mundo throws an infected bonesaw in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and slows them by 40% for 2 seconds.

mechanics.evidence: Mundo throws an infected bonesaw in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and slows them by 40% for 2 seconds.

parts.text: Infected Bonesaw has a minimum damage threshold, and is capped against monsters.
If the bonesaw hits an enemy, Dr. Mundo heals for 50% of the health cost, increased to 100% against champions or monsters.

mechanics.evidence: Mundo heals for 50% of the health cost, increased to 100% against champions or monsters.

notes: This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the start of the cast time.
Spell shield blocking the ability's effects on the enemy does not prevent Dr. Mundo from receiving the health cost refund.

name: Infected Cleaver

mechanics.evidence: Mundo hurls a cleaver in the target direction, dealing magic damage to the first enemy it hits and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.

parts.text: Infected Cleaver has a minimum damage threshold, and is capped against minions and monsters.
If Infected Cleaver hits an enemy, Dr. Mundo heals for 50% of the health cost, increased to 100% if he hits a champion or kills an enemy.

mechanics.evidence: Mundo heals for 50% of the health cost, increased to 100% if he hits a champion or kills an enemy.

notes:

Spell shield blocking the ability's effects on the enemy does not prevent Dr. Mundo from receiving the health cost refund.

name: Maximum Dosage

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Dr. Mundo injects himself with chemicals to become enhanced for 10 seconds, gaining increased base health, bonus movement speed, and bonus health regeneration.
At rank 3, Maximum Dosage's increased base health and bonus health regeneration are both increased by 5% for each enemy champion within 1200 units at the time of cast.

notes: The health regeneration granted by Maximum Dosage adjusts dynamically to Dr. Mundo's maximum health.
The health regeneration granted by Maximum Dosage is special cased to be increased by Axiom Arcanist.
Maximum Dosage will end prematurely upon entering resurrection.
Against 5 champions, Rank 3 Maximum Dosage will heal 85% Maximum health regeneration & 50% Missing Bonus health

name: Sadism

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Dr. Mundo regenerates health over 12 seconds and gains bonus movement speed for the duration.

mechanics.evidence: Mundo regenerates health over 12 seconds and gains bonus movement speed for the duration.

notes: Sadism adjusts dynamically to Dr. Mundo's maximum health.
Sadism will continue its effect through resurrection.
Sadism is not affected by Revitalize as it is considered health regeneration.
Taking into account Grievous Wounds, Sadism will heal for a total of 36 / 51 / 66% of maximum health at a 40% reduction and for a total of 24 / 34 / 44% of maximum health at a 60% reduction.

name: Burning Agony

parts.label: Toggle
parts.text: Toggle: Dr. Mundo sets himself on fire, gaining 30% tenacity and dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds to nearby enemies.

mechanics.evidence: Mundo sets himself on fire, gaining 30% tenacity and dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds to nearby enemies.

parts.text: Burning Agony can be toggled off after 0.5 seconds of toggling on.
If Dr. Mundo's health falls below Burning Agony's health cost while toggled on, the ability is toggled off automatically and put on a 1 second cooldown.

notes: Toggle abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse passive.

Burning Agony can be cast even if Dr. Mundo doesn't have the sufficient amount of health to pay for the health cost.
  - As with all abilities with health costs, Burning Agony will not reduce Dr. Mundo's health below 1.
The Tenacity increase stacks additively with the tenacity reduction from Brittle, but multiplicatively with other sources.

name: Heart Zapper

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Dr. Mundo charges up a defibrillator for up to 3 seconds, dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds to nearby enemies and storing 80 – 95 (based on level)% of post-mitigation damage he takes as grey health on his health bar, reduced to 25% after the first 0.75 seconds.

values.context: Mundo charges up a defibrillator for up to 3 seconds, dealing magic damage every 0.25 seconds to nearby enemies and storing 80 – 95 (based on level)% of post-mitigation damage he takes as grey health on his health bar, reduced to 25% after the first 0.75 seconds.

parts.text: Heart Zapper can be recast after 0.5 seconds within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.

parts.label: Recast
parts.text: Recast: Dr. Mundo detonates the defibrillator, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and healing for 50% of grey health, increased to 100% if at least one enemy champion or large monster is hit.

mechanics.evidence: Mundo detonates the defibrillator, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and healing for 50% of grey health, increased to 100% if at least one enemy champion or large monster is hit.

notes: The charge up applies persistent area damage and the detonation deals area damage.
Spell shield will only block the detonation.
Heart Zapper will occasionally deal an additional tick of damage.

Heart Zapper and its recast will buffer and cast at the end of Infected Bonesaw cast time if attempted to cast during it.
  - As with all buffering of this type, another input such as a movement command can override the buffering of the spell again.
